policy.title: Public-housing recommendation readiness
policy.intro: This view audits the information quality and neighborhood-analysis readiness of loaded housing stock, not synthetic citizen behavior.
policy.actualDataNote: Operational prototype aggregated from real housing records in the current database.
policy.readinessDescription: Data conditions that can exclude homes or weaken explanations.
policy.action1: Geocode missing housing first to reduce recommendation blind spots.
policy.action2: Structure elevator and parking fields from notices so exclusions are explainable.
policy.action3: Publish neighborhood scores and source years alongside listing details.
policy.demandTitle: Unmet interest signals in this service
policy.demandDescription: Counts new-housing information alerts requested after searches returned no results. This is not an official measure of demand across all Busan residents.

policy.zeroSupplyDescription: Over 10,000 residents and not a single public rental unit.
policy.amenityDescription: Coffee, convenience, Korean food, pharmacy and salon counts for the most under-supplied 동. Thin on both means higher priority.

about.title: About
about.intro: Haru started from Busan's shrinking population and the ~50% decline rate for public housing lottery winners. We show the surrounding neighborhood first, not just deposit and floor size.
about.problemBody: Supply-side notices (size, deposit) alone don't tell citizens whether a listing is actually a neighborhood they'd want to live in. Checking nearby cafés, gyms, or convenience stores meant searching separately for every listing. Haru recommends housing by combining hard conditions with real commercial-district context.
about.bmcBlurb: A public housing and urban development corporation. Provided public rental housing data and a citizen housing-demand channel.
about.sundosoftBlurb: A GIS and data analytics company. Provided fused commercial-district/population data and spatial analysis expertise.
about.dataIntro: Exactly where each dataset from BMC and Sundosoft is used in the product. Figures are what is currently loaded in the database.
